before.requirement: Recognize a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set.
before.reason: The complete before span enum and mark collector have no spoiler span or double-pipe recognition.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS, recognize ||text|| and render the span with x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The flag is a bit in the parser flags that the harness takes from input. Its remaining input bytes can contain the double-pipe syntax; the parser resolves the span and the HTML callbacks emit its tags.
